parsed.answer: This has been raised before. Making the scrollbar always visible is already supported: set "Scrollbar visibility" to Always in Settings > [Profile] > Appearance (or in Defaults to apply to all profiles), available since Terminal 1.17 (terminal#14589). Alternatively, you can turn off "Automatically hide scroll bars in Windows" in Windows Settings > Accessibility > Visual effects, but that is system-wide. Note that the "visible" setting alone still fades the scrollbar out, so use "always". The wider scrollbar request was previously filed as terminal#18937, where the maintainers declined to add a scrollbar width setting because they want to avoid deviating from the standard Windows scrollbar, and the scrollbar width is similar to other Windows apps. Terminal#6565 asked for an always-expanded scrollbar, as it appears on hover, and was closed as a duplicate of #3454, so that is where discussion of it is tracked. There is no existing option to widen the scrollbar, so that part of your request has not been accepted.
